given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to process an incoming Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system exposes the active Service Area Definition to the Order Allocation Engine
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine retrieves the active Service Area Definition for real-time validation

given_when_then.given: An Order Request contains an address within the active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine validates the address against the exposed Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine proceeds with order processing

given_when_then.given: An Order Request contains an address outside the active Service Area Definition
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine validates the address against the exposed Service Area Definition
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine rejects the order and logs the rejection reason as 'outside service zone'

given_when_then.given: A new version of a Service Area Definition is published
given_when_then.when: The system exposes the updated definition to the Order Allocation Engine
given_when_then.then: The Order Allocation Engine receives the new version as the active Service Area Definition immediately

success_criteria: The Order Allocation Engine can successfully retrieve the active Service Area Definition.
Orders with addresses inside the active Service Area Definition are accepted by the Order Allocation Engine.
Orders with addresses outside the active Service Area Definition are rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
The rejection reason for orders outside the service area includes the text 'outside service zone'.
The Order Allocation Engine uses the most recently published Service Area Definition for validation.
